items.title: No Xcode project
items.text: A Swift package and one settings file become a real Mac app.

items.title: Extensions
items.text: Widgets and other extensions go into PlugIns with the app's identifier and version.

items.title: Translations and icon
items.text: Every .lproj folder, and an icon in all sizes from one picture or one command.

items.title: Permissions that stay
items.text: A self-signed identity keeps Full Disk Access and other grants across rebuilds.

items.title: Disk image
items.text: The app, a link to Applications and your guide, signed, in dist/.

items.title: Notarized
items.text: With a Developer ID and a notary profile, macOS opens it without a warning.
